evidence: The ALD process used here was characterised earlier by Rampelberg et al. 7,34–36,40 and is based on tetrakis[ethylmethylamino]vanadium (V(NC2H5CH3)4, or TEMA V) in combination with H2O and ozone. The precursor was held in a stainless steel container at 70 /C14C with argon as a carrier gas.
